description: Submit the answers and documents an `evidence` requirement asks for, in one request, keyed as get_rfi_evidence_form lists them. Files are base64 data URLs ('data:application/pdf;base64,...'). The requirement moves to 'submitted' for Stables compliance to review; approving it releases the held payment once nothing else is outstanding. Confirm the content with a human before sending: it goes to compliance as the customer's answer.

answers.description: Answers keyed by the form's field keys and document wire_field names, e.g. { funds_origin, funds_origin_explanation, supporting_documents: ['data:application/pdf;base64,...'] }

name: submit_rfi_evidence
title: Submit information request evidence
